text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ever since dedicating herself to the 
project, Sirius Symboli has been compared 
countless times to Symboli Rudolf and the 
legendary Speed Symboli.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ignoring that background, she runs by her 
own choice. She conveys that comparing 
oneself to others is meaningless.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, it was precisely because of who 
she was that she wanted to set her as the 
wall to overcome. She had to surpass that 
immense strength if she ever hoped to take 
on the world.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They promised to give it their all in an 
all-out showdown between Sirius Symboli 
and <chrname> in the upcoming Representative 
Exchange Race.
